data_objects.name: country_year_indicators
data_objects.meaning: Country-year demographic and economic indicators with continent labels.
data_objects.notes: The GDP-per-capita currency basis and price-year convention are not stated.

variables.name: year
variables.meaning: Calendar year of the country observation.

variables.name: pop
variables.meaning: Population associated with the country and year.

variables.name: lifeexp
variables.meaning: Life expectancy associated with the country and year.

variables.name: gdppercap
variables.meaning: Gross domestic product per person for the country and year.

variables.name: continent
variables.meaning: Continent category associated with the country.

structure.description: Each row represents one country-year observation, with country and year forming the natural composite key.
continent is a higher-level geographic grouping for country.

uncertainties: The source, collection methodology, population reference date, and life-expectancy definition are not supplied.
The monetary unit, purchasing-power treatment, and inflation basis for gdppercap are unspecified.
annotation_notes: Economic units are left null because train.csv does not state a currency or valuation basis.
